description: The same repeated-placeholder template under maximumInterpolatedOutputCharacters 11. 'abcd' isolates to 6 characters; the first occurrence fits, and the second is offered a remaining budget of 5, so the MEMOIZED path's own limit check (render line 210) rejects it. Note the threshold differs from the first render's: line 210 compares the ISOLATED length against the remaining budget, while BidiUtils.isolate line 98 compares the RAW length -- and the reported maximum is the FULL limit (11), not the remaining budget.
